scope: Automatic compatible prefix selection, child environment handoff and launcher ensure; no runtime payload or numerical algorithm changes

checks.command: TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

regressions: Fresh Ubuntu 22 fixture restores the base prefix plus verified overlay
Ubuntu 22 with original v4 preserves every original receipt byte and restores/reuses a compatible sibling
Ubuntu 24 reuses the original prefix; an existing compatible sibling is discoverable if the base is absent
Explicit CLI/environment prefixes remain overrides; incompatible explicit targets are rejected
Unknown selected installations are preserved; selected symlinks are rejected
Standalone helper and launcher share AST-identical default selection policy and archive pin
Selected CTOPD_RUNTIME_PREFIX and CTOPD_ROOT reach the forwarded Python process with the assigned GPU mask
Real launcher ensure keeps the assigned visibility mask; dry-run never calls ensure or writes files
H1b canary uses the same launcher policy and does not require a runtime flag
All existing Strict, SimCT, MP, ALIGN, TRUST and H1b CPU tests pass
qualification: Offline fixtures and CPU regression only; this new entrypoint flow has not run on a company node/B200
compute: No GPU job, new archive download, dependency install or runtime rebuild
